name: Kanao Tsuyuri
summary: Kanao Tsuyuri is a Demon Slayer and the Tsuguko of Shinobu Kocho. She was adopted by Kanae and Shinobu Kocho after being rescued from an abusive childhood. Through rigorous training, Kanao became an exceptionally skilled swordswoman and mastered Flower Breathing. She possesses extraordinary physical abilities, eyesight, reflexes, and combat instincts, making her one of the most talented young Demon Slayers.

stats.range: Extended Melee Range, Several Meters with Breathing Techniques

weaknesses: Her final Flower Breathing technique severely damages her eyesight
notes: Kanao's Post-Demon Slayer Training key. She is an exceptionally talented swordswoman and Flower Breathing user. Her extraordinary eyesight allows her to perceive extremely fast movements and attacks.
